convergence:

definingCharacteristics: Shape of public: The question links back to where should the public health system have the ability to act. Acting on health collectively. centralTension:
central theme: continued ascendancy of the individual (people/population/indiviudal centric)

name: Team 1
definingCharacteristics:
1. The role of the university is changing -- with educational offerings becoming more accessible and less expensive, universities need to clearly articulate their value. 
2. In this scenario, we are living in a constant ethos of adaptation. We do not rely on doing the same thing over and over, we value a comprehensive and inclusive approach to understanding the world and collaboratively working to make it better. We see less assumed power across government and corporations, connection is held with the people.
centralTension: This scenario speaks to a future where connection is kept and fostered by the people and isn't lost to political system or corporations. There's a responsiveness to how and when we need to adapt and we can do that because we can see institutional recovery take place due to our distributed partner workforce.
newNormal: The role of governmental public health could shift to new roles due to the more distributed public health workforce. In this scenario, work would align with partners based on strengths.
brokenAssumption: Public health isn't driving for more money and more staff, but rather deeper connections, more effective programs and greater accountability.
